svg.title: Dyspnea decision chart: tempo first (acute minutes to hours versus chronic), then system and lung compartment; each compartment column lists the life-threatening acute causes to exclude first and the chronic causes, with alveolar filling by fluid, pus, blood or tumour

svg.text: Dyspnea: ACUTE (minutes to hours) or CHRONIC? Then WHICH SYSTEM, and where in the lung?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: acute: exclude the LIFE-THREATENING causes first (red boxes)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: chronic and NOT the heart or lungs: anemia, anxiety, deconditioning, hyperthyroidism, metabolic acidosis
